  • Buses run between Sydenham, Wolli Creek and Arncliffe.

infoLinks.urlText: L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line partial closure during Parramatta Lanes
infoLinks.content:
From Wednesday 22 to Saturday 25 October, due to road closures and for pedestrian safety during Parramatta Lanes, L4 Westmead and Carlingford Line light rail services will not run between Westmead and Parramatta Square during the following times: 
  • From 5pm to 11pm on Wednesday 22 and Thursday 23 October  
  • From 5pm to 11.30pm on Friday 24 and Saturday 25 October  
Light rail services will continue to run between Parramatta Square and Carlingford. 

During this time, use alternative transport including trains, regular bus services, L4 replacement bus services or walking if able to, between Westmead and Parramatta Square. 

L4 replacement bus services: 

Replacement bus services will run every 10 to 15 minutes from 5pm to 11pm on Wednesday 22 and Thursday 23 October, and from 5pm to 11.30pm on Friday 24 and Saturday 25 October. These times may vary depending on road traffic. 

Replacement buses will not stop at the following locations: 
  • Westmead Hospital – please use the alternative stop at Westmead Station (approx. 6 minutes walk) 
  • Ngara – please use the alternative stop at Benaud Oval (approx. 5 minutes walk) 
Most replacement buses will be accessible; if not, wait for the next service. 

Allow extra travel time and use the Trip Planner or check travel alerts to see if your travel is affected. 

Check signs at stops and see the event page for more info.

infoLinks.urlText: L1 Dulwich Hill Line partial closure due to maintenance
infoLinks.content:
From Saturday 1 to Friday 7 November, L1 Dulwich Hill Line light rail services will not run between Central and Convention due to planned trackwork and maintenance works.
 
During this time:
  • L1 light rail services will continue to run between Convention and Dulwich Hill.
  • Use alternative transport including regular bus services, L1 replacement bus services, or walking if able to, between Central Grand Concourse and Convention.
  • Due to road closures, L1 replacement buses will only stop at Central Grand Concourse, Convention and The Star. There will be no replacement buses at the following stops: Capitol Square, Paddy’s Markets, Exhibition Centre, Pyrmont Bay.
